explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/559 (Beck): is R̂(G) ≪_d n for G with n vertices and maximum degree d? Disproved for d = 3 by Rödl–Szemerédi. sizeRamsey G G is the minimal edge count of an F such that every red/blue colouring contains G in one colour. The statement negates ∀ d ∃ C, R̂(G) ≤ C|V(G)| over finite G with maxDegree ≤ d. Faithful.
